description: HOW TO EDIT: every row below is one piece of the website. Edit cells and the site updates on its next load. Don't change the header row above, the 'section' values, or the 'key' values.

ICONS (icon_or_image column): use any slug from https://simpleicons.org (github, unity, godotengine, blender...). Special values: 'linkedin' and 'email' are built into the site. 'txt:C#' shows the text C# instead of an icon.
IMAGES (icon_or_image column on project/jam rows): media/filename.png for files in the site's media folder, or paste any direct image/GIF url from the web.
TAGS: comma separated. Plain words become green [tool] tags. Words starting with @ become grey company tags. Example: 'c#, c++, @blizzard'.
ORDER sorts rows within their section (1 = first). VISIBLE: set to FALSE to hide a row without deleting it.
